dialogues.speaker: Camotli
dialogues.text: Hmm... What should I put in today's healthy meal?

dialogues.speaker: Camotli
dialogues.text: Yes— Seriously? What are you giving me that look for? "Healthy" doesn't necessarily mean "unpalatable."

dialogues.speaker: Camotli
dialogues.text: As long as it satisfies your body's needs, any food can be considered healthy. After all, different people have different nutritional requirements.

dialogues.speaker: Camotli
dialogues.text: In fact, if it doesn't taste good, it really shouldn't be considered healthy at all! Am I right?

dialogues.speaker: Camotli
dialogues.text: Anyway, back to the matter at hand — are we going to eat Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce with Grainfruit Chips, or Meat Stew with Volcano Braised Rice...

dialogues.speaker: Camotli
dialogues.text: Goodbye. I hope you have a wonderful day!

dialogues.speaker: Camotli
dialogues.text: Food recommendations... Hmm, you're probably not super hungry yet, are you? How about some Puffed Grainfruit Bars to get those tastebuds going?

dialogues.speaker: Camotli
dialogues.text: Healthy, delicious, and relatively easy to make! This one's on me — and trust me, nutritious meals aren't anywhere near as bad as some people make them out to be!
